purpose: Teach: 挙げる/鋭く/有権者/流入/伝染病/地形/能動/神宮

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、症例の、本気で、絶対、挙げる、絶対、議論、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Ren, I really do appreciate how the medical team discusses case findings with such seriousness.
lines.style: Even, measured delivery. Warm but professional distance. Slight emphasis on 'appreciate'—genuine but not effusive. Shoulders relaxed.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 貴院、本気で、絶対、症状、絶対、鋭く、絶対、診断、絶対、されているそうですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Your hospital really does seem to diagnose symptoms with remarkable sharpness, Doctor. I'm truly grateful.
lines.style: Genuine curiosity in the opening. Respectful but not deferential. Slight pause before 'truly grateful'—sincerity breaking through formality. Quiet admiration.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。本気で、絶対、有権者、絶対、への、絶対、医療政策、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、ご説明、絶対、参加しました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The medical team has been thorough in explaining our health policy approach to stakeholders and participating actively.
lines.style: Direct and clear. Professional register—informative without condescension. Steady pace. Brief, confident—no hedging.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 観光客の、本気で、絶対、流入、絶対、貴院、絶対、医療対応、絶対、されているそうですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I've noticed your hospital really does handle the medical response to the increased tourist flow quite well.
lines.style: Observant, thoughtful tone. Genuine appreciation showing through. Slight hesitation before 'quite well'—measuring words carefully, not overstating.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。本気で、絶対、伝染病、絶対、対策、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、徹底、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The medical team has been thorough in our infectious disease protocols and prevention measures.
lines.style: Patient, steady. Clinical precision without coldness. Breath support on key terms—'thorough,' 'protocols.' Slight warmth underneath the professionalism.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 山岳の、本気で、絶対、地形、絶対、医療搬送、絶対、貴院、絶対、対応されているんですね、先生、本気for、感謝
lines.en: I imagine your hospital handles the medical transport logistics quite well given the mountainous terrain around here.
lines.style: Reflective, genuinely curious. Respectful inquiry—not asking to test but to understand. Slight lean forward in the voice. Patient.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。患者さんの、本気で、絶対、能動、絶対、的な、絶対、参加、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、重視しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We emphasize active patient participation in their own care. The medical team considers that essential.
lines.style: Patient, affirming. Conviction on 'essential'—not harsh, but clear about what matters. Warm undertone. Like she's sharing something she believes in.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本気で、絶対、神宮、絶対、外苑の、絶対、ジョギング、絶対、患者さんに、絶対、おすすめ、絶対、されていますか?先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Do you recommend Meiji Shrine or Gaien jogging to your patients as part of their recovery and wellness, Doctor?
lines.style: Thoughtful, genuinely interested question. Respectful pause before the question mark. Warm curiosity—not testing, appreciating. Closing note of sincerity.
